initial_baseline.resume_policy: infrastructure failures may resume the same unfilled slot; completed outcomes are immutable

retest.selection_policy: representative failures chosen by distinct root-cause family and generalizability, never by easiest expected gain

outcomes.automated_pass: terminal policy and every objective scene, trace, privacy, route, recovery, and fixture-invariance check pass
outcomes.manual_evidence_pending: automated scope passes but one or more declared manual checks have no reviewed evidence
outcomes.full_acceptance: automated_pass and every declared manual check passes
outcomes.partial: at least one objective check passes but automated_pass is false
outcomes.infrastructure_failure: Rhino, MCP, model provider, or evaluator infrastructure prevents a valid attempt; excluded from capability denominator and shown separately

human_intervention_policy: Only the six frozen clarification answers and declared cancel/rollback test controls count; no developer coaching or answer changes are allowed.
